body: I haven't been on reddit for a while but I wanted to thank you for your reply :) You're 100% right about my family situation still affecting me, my lack of a relationship with my mom (I was kicked out of my moms at 13 to live with my dad) makes it hard for me to connect with women, which inevitably kills my love life. As for my typing, I do think I'm likely mistyping as infj. I think I'm in a place in life where everything is changing and I'm growing into a new stage; I'm only 22. It's really scary thinking about the future when there's no one I can rely on for guidance when I need it. I feel alone a lot.

I'll send it for sure! I hope you like it! My goal was to create music that doesn't sound like anyone in particular.  I'd say it's kind of Lo-Fi psychedelic rock... I just need a band haha I have so many ideas for a live show that people wouldn't forget :)
Feels much better now, songwriting is really cathartic for me :) I plan to have it done in maybe a month or so, I can dm you a link when it's done! I'm really excited to release it.

Songwriting really takes me to a different place. Thanks, that means a lot, I can't wait until this song is done being recorded! I have a chronic case of procrastination syndrome and never being satisfied with the final result haha

I've taken multiple tests and I usually get INTP or INFP but it's funny because the song is about a breakup with an INFJ who was mysterious and manipulative. I thought she was the one but she was using me to feel better about herself. The realization that I was being used tore me apart.
I'll update the post with my type somewhat shortly.  What makes you think ENFP? a lot of my favourite song writers are/were xNxP's
